The Digital
Prescription.

The primary challenge was building a system that could handle high-concurrency doctor scheduling while maintaining HIPAA-compliant security for patient records. We focused on a "Mobile-First" approach for patients and a "Data-Dense" dashboard for medical professionals.

Using the MERN stack with WebRTC integration, we enabled low-latency video consultations, integrated directly with the scheduling engine to ensure consultations only happen during confirmed time slots.
